ApplyCoordinationWithCode.description_en: Use a coordination code to initiate a coordination connection and retrieve a coordination connection credential
ApplyCoordinationWithCode.description_zh: 使用协同码发起协同连接，获取协同连接凭证

EndAllCoordinationByOwner.description_en: The resource owner ends all active coordination tasks for a resource and synchronizes the deactivation of its coordination codes
EndAllCoordinationByOwner.description_zh: 资源所有者主动结束当前资源的所有协同任务，同步失效协同码

GenerateCoordinationCode.description_en: Generates a coordination code for the current account's connected cloud desktop. You can share this code with other accounts to allow them to connect to the same cloud desktop
GenerateCoordinationCode.description_zh: 为当前账号和连接中的云电脑生成一个协同码，通过将协同码分享给其他账号，可以让其他账号连接到当前云电脑
